shippingOrigins.incoterms: FOB Foshan or CIF Australian port — confirm per order

australianPortsAndLogistics.customsBroker: Always use a licensed customs broker for commercial furniture imports
australianPortsAndLogistics.importDuty: 5% import duty on most furniture categories + 10% GST on CIF value
australianPortsAndLogistics.quarantineRisk: Timber and natural material items may require AQIS inspection — add 3–5 business days buffer

warehouseOperations.receivingProcess: Count all cartons against packing list at receiving — photograph any damaged cartons before signing
warehouseOperations.storageRequirements: Furniture stored flat or standing — never on end for panel goods; seating stored upright
warehouseOperations.insurancePrinciple: All goods must be insured from point of loading to point of delivery to client site
warehouseOperations.stockingRisk: Do not pre-stock large volumes without confirmed orders — furniture models update frequently from suppliers

vehicleTypes.smallProjects: 1–2 tonne van or small rigid truck
vehicleTypes.mediumProjects: 4–6 tonne rigid truck with tail lift
vehicleTypes.largeProjects: Semi-trailer or B-double — confirm loading dock access first

deliveryRequirements: Confirm loading dock availability or street parking zone
Check lift dimensions before delivery — minimum 2.0m W × 2.0m D × 2.4m H
Confirm delivery time window with building manager minimum 5 business days prior
CBD buildings typically restrict delivery to before 10am
Protect lobby and lift with blankets and carpet runners before moving furniture

supplyChainRisks: Chinese New Year factory closures (January–February) — add 4–6 weeks to orders placed in December–January
Port congestion at Nansha/Shekou — build 1-week buffer into all sea freight estimates
Currency fluctuation — AUD/CNY moves can affect landed cost by 5–10% over a 3-month period
Supplier capacity — confirm production slot before promising client delivery date
